sentence: This project builds an imaging stress test that checks how a whole joint responds to loading and looks for early signs of osteoarthritis.
This project builds statistical tools that combine brain activity and genetic information to study how genes and brain connections lead to Alzheimer's disease.
This project builds gene editing tools carried by lipid nanoparticles and tests how they affect bone cells from patients with Apert Syndrome.
This project studies tissue samples from rhesus macaques with transplanted kidneys to see when immunosuppression drugs can safely be stopped.
This project tests a therapy using engineered T cells to remove the cells that make antibodies blocking kidney transplants.
This project examines how pathogens, vectors, hosts and their environments relate in vector borne diseases.
This project tries to find out how a cancer marker protein weakens the immune response in pancreatic cancer and whether targeting it helps.
This project combines clinical, neurocognitive and blood measurement data to study how cannabis products affect the endocannabinoid system across the lifespan.
This project compares episomes from treated people who have died and from mice to find signs linked to persistence.
This project studies whether irregular sleep and body clock timing raise the short-term risk of suicidal thoughts and behaviors in adolescents.
This project builds machine learning models that help choose extra treatment for people with colorectal cancer after surgery.
This project studies how a molecule that keeps the mature brain healthy works and tests whether it helps in models of Alzheimer's disease.
This project builds MRI methods that check the heart and lungs of children in a single rapid scan without ionizing radiation.
This project tries to detect tumor-specific DNA methylation in plasma and builds more sensitive methods to find lung cancer.
This project studies changes in mitochondria and their genes in aggressive prostate cancer using preclinical models and human tumors.
This project uses whole exome sequencing to find genetic differences in the immune system linked to severe sepsis in children.
This project does research on cancer to find its causes, predict risk, improve screening and genetic testing, and reduce cancer risks.
This project works with local communities to help schools prevent substance use among Native Hawaiian and Pacific Islander youth in rural areas.
